ideas.children_he: הַמְשׁוֹרֵר מֵרִים עֵינַיִם אֶל ה׳ וּמְבַקֵּשׁ עֶזְרָה מִמַּצָּבוֹ הַנָּמוּךְ.
ideas.children_en: The psalmist lifts his eyes to God, seeking help from his lowly situation.

ideas.children_he: הָעָם מַמְתִּין לְרַחֲמֵי ה׳ כְּמוֹ מְשָׁרְתִים הַמַּבִּיטִים לְיַד אֲדוֹנֵיהֶם.
ideas.children_en: The people wait for God's mercy like servants watching their master's hand.

ideas.children_he: הֵם מְבַקְּשִׁים חֶסֶד כִּי שָׂבְעוּ מִלַּעַג וּמִבּוּז שֶׁל אֲנָשִׁים גֵּאִים.
ideas.children_en: They ask for kindness because they have endured enough proud people's mockery and contempt.
